title: 皐月賞の後に・ビジョン

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After being defeated in the Satsuki Sho, Biwa Hayahide decides to recalculate her equation from scratch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Narita Taishin's extraordinary determination—the destabilizing factor—won't be easy to account for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Winning Ticket shouts her resolve to win the Japanese Derby at the top of her lungs, almost as if to convince herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Can we rebuild Biwa Hayahide's winning equation in time for the Japanese Derby, where both of her indomitable rivals will be?
